newsitem.title: USA: Hallmark to acquire stationer William Arthur.
newsitem.headline: Hallmark to acquire stationer William Arthur.

text.p: Hallmark Cards Inc said Wednesday it had signed an agreement to acquire William Arthur Inc, a Maine designer, manufacturer and marketer of customized and pre-packaged stationery products.
The acquisition was expected to close by the end of July. Terms of the deal were not disclosed.
William Arthur employs 200 people, and its 1996 revenues exceeded $12 million.
Hallmark said William Arthur will operate as a wholly owned subsidiary and independent operating unit and will continue to operate out of its West Kennebunk headquarters.
Former owners Bill and June De Jonge will retire from William Arthur. Tim Cole, vice president of customer service, has been named president of the firm.
